== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Burrow Guardians are elite commando units summoned through magic. They are characterized as rabbit-like beings, specifically Voidhoppers, whose defensive nature is derived from the instinctual tendency of rabbits to use warrens for protection. This biological trait is combined with human concepts of guardianship, resulting in soldiers that resemble the power-armored troops of the [[Galactic Union]]. In combat, they utilize advanced technology including power armor equipped with ocular scanners, floating support drones, and automatic [[plasma]] rifles or [[chaos rifles]]. They are capable of providing effective cover fire and tactical support alongside other summoned entities like Thornfur Brawler{{!}}Thornfur Brawlers.}}
